_comment: Dated content that expires, and who re-checks it. Read by .github/scripts/check-content-review.mjs,
which runs weekly and opens a GitHub issue when an item falls due.
This file tracks; it never edits. Every string below is client-approved copy and only its owner
changes it — see docs/DECISIONS.md #13a for why rewriting is deliberately NOT automated.
To add an item: give it an id, a dueOn date (ISO), an owner, and the exact strings to re-check.
To close one: set "done": true with a dated note. Do not delete it — the record is the point.

items.title: Learning Matrix: the 2026 maths paper has been sat — these statements are now past tense
items.why: The Year 4 maths paper is sat on Wednesday 7 October 2026 (8:10-9:25am). From 8 October the page describes a future exam that has already happened. The site's whole argument is precision about the school system, so a stale future tense here undermines the thing it is selling. Nothing will flag this on its own: no test fails and no build breaks.
strings: Problem section: 'Year 4, from October 2026. The Examinations Board runs the new Learning Matrix nationally...'
Level block 1, bullet 3: 'If your child is in Year 4 this year, they sit the Learning Matrix maths paper on 7 October.'
Level block 1, bullet 3: 'An assessment now tells you what they will find out in October, with Years 5 and 6 still available to act on it.'
Gap chart annotation: label 'OCT 2026' on stop S4
items.decideAlso: What should the Year 4 bullet say to a parent who now HAS the result slip? That is a new argument, not a tense change - the result reports a mastery level plus an intervention recommendation, not a grade.
editIn: BM, if shipped by then: copywriting/COPY-DRAFT-MS.md

items.title: Learning Matrix: confirm the Form 3 rollout before describing it as current
items.why: The page states 'Form 3, from 2027. Same idea, five papers this time.' That is a claim about future MOE policy, and policy moves. Confirm with Lembaga Peperiksaan that the Form 3 rollout is going ahead, on what dates, and with how many papers, BEFORE the page stops describing it as a future plan.
strings: Problem section: 'Form 3, from 2027. Same idea, five papers this time.'
Gap chart annotation: label 'FROM 2027' on stop F3
items.decideAlso: If the rollout slipped or changed shape, the Problem section's central argument (two independent checks before SPM) needs re-checking, not just the date.
editIn: BM, if shipped by then: copywriting/COPY-DRAFT-MS.md

items.title: Annual fee review - the page states rates 'apply for 2026'
items.why: Approved copy: 'Rates shown apply for 2026 and are reviewed once a year.' On 1 January 2027 that sentence dates itself, whether or not the rates change.
strings: Pricing: 'Fees are paid before the first session of each month, by DuitNow or bank transfer. Rates shown apply for 2026 and are reviewed once a year.'
